Construct and Validate a dicom_volume Object

Source: R/dicom-volume.R
new_dicom_volume.Rd

Low-level S3 constructor and validator for 3D ([rows, cols, slices]) and 4D ([rows, cols, slices, frames]) medical imaging volumes paired with an exact 4x4 homogeneous voxel-to-world affine matrix in DICOM "LPS" or NIfTI "RAS" physical coordinates (millimeters).

Usage

new_dicom_volume(
  voxels,
  affine = diag(4L),
  coord_system = c("LPS", "RAS"),
  spacing = NULL,
  direction = NULL,
  frame_meta = NULL,
  uids = list(),
  modality = NA_character_,
  units = NA_character_,
  diagnostics = list(),
  provenance = list()
)

# S3 method for class 'dicom_volume'
dim(x)

# S3 method for class 'dicom_volume'
as.array(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'dicom_volume'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

voxels

Numeric 2D matrix [rows, cols] (automatically promoted to [rows, cols, 1L]), 3D array [rows, cols, slices], or 4D array [rows, cols, slices, frames].

affine

4x4 finite numeric homogeneous voxel-to-world affine matrix whose bottom row is c(0, 0, 0, 1). Defaults to diag(4L).

coord_system

World coordinate convention: "LPS" (DICOM Patient Coordinate System: Left-Posterior-Superior, default) or "RAS" (Right-Anterior-Superior).

spacing

Optional length-3 non-negative numeric vector c(dr, dc, dz) in millimeters. Automatically derived from the Euclidean norms of columns 1..3 of affine when NULL.

direction

Optional named list with length-3 numeric direction cosine vectors d_row, d_col, and normal. Automatically derived from affine when NULL.

frame_meta

Optional tibble::tibble (or data.frame, coerced to a tibble) storing per-slice or per-frame DICOM header metadata. Defaults to an empty tibble.

uids

Named list of DICOM study/series/frame-of-reference UIDs.

modality

Single character string (e.g. "CT", "MR", "PT") or NA_character_.

units

Single character string giving voxel physical units (e.g. "HU", "BQML", "g/mL") or NA_character_.

diagnostics

Named list of geometry diagnostics (e.g. irregular_spacing, gantry_tilt_deg).

provenance

list of chronological provenance entries recording transformations applied to the volume.

x

A dicom_volume object.

...

Additional arguments passed to or from methods.

Value

A validated S3 object of class "dicom_volume".

Details

By convention, 0-based voxel indices (r, c, s) map to physical world coordinates via affine %*% c(r, c, s, 1), where:

  • Column 1 (r step along rows) is d_col * dr

  • Column 2 (c step along columns) is d_row * dc

  • Column 3 (s step across slices) is the inter-slice step vector

  • Column 4 is the physical origin of voxel (r = 0, c = 0, s = 0) ([1, 1, 1] 1-based)

Examples

vox <- array(seq_len(8 * 8 * 4), dim = c(8L, 8L, 4L))
aff <- diag(c(0.8, 0.8, 2.5, 1.0))
aff[1:3, 4] <- c(-10, -10, 0)
vol <- new_dicom_volume(vox, affine = aff, modality = "CT", units = "HU")
vol
#> <dicom_volume [CT] 8x8x4 | coord=LPS | units=HU>
#>   spacing: (0.8, 0.8, 2.5) mm | origin: (-10, -10, 0) mm
#>   frame_meta: 0 row(s) | provenance: 0 step(s)
is_dicom_volume(vol)
#> [1] TRUE
